Name: Let Me Remap
Author: Ekysoh
Description:
Lets you remap physical controller buttons to other inputs, keyboard keys, or key combinations. Customize your control layout directly from the menu.

[i]If you use [color=#f1c232][b]Cinderbox[/b][/color], this is a part of the [b]Cinderbox Pack[/b] file that can be downloaded during setup and on the Home screen.[/i]

[line]
[color=#b6d7a8][b][size=4]Features[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Remap controller buttons to other buttons, keys, or hotkey combos.[/*]
[*]Configure bindings directly inside the game menu.[/*]
[*]Works seamlessly with standard controller setups.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#b6d7a8][b][size=4]Setup[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Requires SMAPI 4.3.0 or later.[/*]
[*]Compatible on PC, Cinderbox, and SMAPI for Android.[/*]
[*][b]Does NOT use GMCM.[/b] Open the standard in-game options, scroll down and click [b]Remap Controller Buttons[/b] to configure.[/*]
[/list]
[color=#b6d7a8][b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b][/color]
[list]
[*][b]PC[/b]: Download the file and extract it into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*][b]Cinderbox[/b]: This is a part of the [b]Cinderbox Pack[/b] file that can be downloaded during setup and on the Home screen. You don't need to download from here.[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI for Android[/b]: Download the file and install it with your launcher's Mod Manager. Please do not extract it manually.[/*]
[/list]‎‎
[line]
‎
‎For quick support, please join the [url=https://discord.gg/cinderbox-1464708507923124264][b]Cinderbox Discord server[/b][/url].
